title: FOMC communications blackout begins (through 2027-12-09) — the November 2027 Consumer Confidence print falls inside it
source: EST: derived this session from the Board's own stated rule and cross-checked against a decode this repo already holds. THE RULE IS RE-APPLIED, NOT INHERITED: federalreserve.gov's blackout-period policy states verbatim that "the blackout period will begin at 12:00 a.m. Eastern Time the second Saturday before a meeting ... if the Committee meeting starts on a Tuesday, the blackout period will begin at the start of the Saturday that falls ten days earlier", and ends at the end of the Thursday following the meeting's conclusion. The December 2027 meeting was read direct this session off federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes, 2026-09-06), whose 2027 panel gives "December 7-8*" with the SEP asterisk. Dec 7 2027 is a Tuesday, ten days earlier is Saturday 2027-11-27, and the meeting concludes Wednesday Dec 8 so the window closes at the end of Thursday 2027-12-09. CORROBORATED INDEPENDENTLY by the decode this repo already carries: the fomc-blackout-start-2027-04-17 lane inflated and decoded federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/files/fomc-blackout-period-calendar.pdf on 2026-09-05 and recorded the 2027 shaded windows verbatim as "Jan 16-28, Mar 6-18, Apr 17-29, May 29 -> Jun 10, Jul 17-29, Sep 4-16, Oct 16-28, NOV 27 -> DEC 9" -- a decode this session did not re-run and does not claim to have re-run. Its "Nov 27 -> Dec 9" matches this session's independent arithmetic to the day. STRONGER THAN A SINGLE MATCH: this session derived ALL 56 windows in the 2021-2027 panel from the rule alone, and the eight it returns for 2027 reproduce that decode 8 of 8 -- 01-16, 03-06, 04-17, 05-29, 07-17, 09-04, 10-16, 11-27 -- which is itself the check on the reading. Filed estimate because it is a firm rule applied to a TENTATIVE meeting date: fomccalendars.htm states every 2027 date is "tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it", so the promotion trigger is the 2027-10-26/27 meeting, not a better fetch. Discovered during the consumer-confidence-2027-11-30 initial research, checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the consumer-confidence-2027-11-30 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06), and proposed because it CORRECTS A READING THE PROPOSER WAS HANDED. The consumer-confidence-2027-10-26 lane filed 2027-11-30 with the caution "November is a clean print, not a collision -- the 2027 FOMC panel has no November meeting at all". That is true and it is not the whole picture: there is no November 2027 meeting, but this window puts the 2027-11-30 print FOUR DAYS INSIDE the December meeting's communications blackout. It is the third tracked print to sit inside one, after 2027-10-26 and its own sibling. CLEAN OF COLLISION IS NOT CLEAN OF THE FED, and a taking lane that carries the word "clean" forward without this file will get that wrong. WHAT IS ALREADY SETTLED, so nobody re-spends a session on it: the release-inside-a-blackout channel is MEASURED AND NULL. The consumer-confidence-2027-10-26 lane built it and the consumer-confidence-2027-11-30 lane replicated it character-for-character from the same derived windows -- CB days inside a blackout vs outside, n=23 vs 45, 0 of 9 across SPY/QQQ/XLY/XRT/AMZN/AAPL/XLF/TLT/VIX (SPY 0.921/0.788, p=0.8764, smallest AMZN 0.3574); and blackout WITHOUT collision, clean-in-window n=6 vs clean-outside n=45, also 0 of 9 (smallest VIX 0.0872). With the 08-31 sibling's print-day null and the 09-28 sibling's panel-content null, every Fed-transmission channel this chain can construct is measured and empty. TWO THINGS THAT ARE GENUINELY NEW ABOUT THIS WINDOW. (1) It is the only blackout in the 2027 panel that opens on a Saturday inside a holiday week -- Thanksgiving 2027 is 2027-11-25 and the half session is 2027-11-26 -- so its first two calendar days carry no Fed speech that would have happened anyway, which makes it the weakest instance of the channel rather than the strongest. (2) It brackets the year's LAST projection meeting: the December 7-8 meeting carries a SEP, and its day one on the 7th is the earliest SEP day-one anywhere in the 2021-2027 panel (the observed range is the 7th to the 21st, and 2027-12-07 is the unique instance at the floor). That one-day margin is what FT-consumer-confidence-2027-10-26-2's kill switch watches. The meeting itself is proposed separately as fomc-2027-12-08.from-consumer-confidence-2027-11-30.json in the same PR. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
